name: Google Agent
description: Works across a connected Gmail, Drive and Calendar account, searching and reading messages, documents, spreadsheets, slides and diary entries on request. It stops short of sending anything, which makes it a research and retrieval tool rather than something that acts on your behalf.

official.title: Google Agent by Ryan
official.description: Operates Gmail, Google Drive, and Google Calendar. Searches and reads mail, files, and events. Drive is the Docs, Sheets, and Slides layer. Never sends...
